answer_1.quote: We evaluate several LLMs, including LLaMA 3 70B (AI@Meta, 2024), GPT3.5 . . . We query the LLM to estimate an output number based on a set of (feature, value) pairs given a set of ICL examples . . . The task instruction asks the LLM to estimate the objective of the dataset . . . by just providing a number and no explanation as the output.

answer_2.quote: To assess the performance of the LLMs and the machine learning models on regression tasks, we use Mean Squared Error (MSE) as our main evaluation metric. We also calculate and report the coefficient of determination R^2 and Mean Absolute Error (MAE) in Appendix E.
